value.title: El Búho
value.synopsis: Repeat visits from an owl convince Paula in the gnome's reincarnation, Iván can't believe he killed a man, Fermin fights for his life while losing the paintings, the gang discovers a second door, and Saúl preps a new operative.

value.title: 8 Milímetros
value.synopsis: Nora impresses Héctor with keen powers of observation, but Fermin's expertise in forensics reveals a nearly 6' assailant shooting his nameless contact with Maria in the room. Her behavior points to Iván.

value.title: El Soldadito de Plomo
value.synopsis: Tired of being too passive, Marcos and Iván make bold moves, which Paula and Evelyn unknowingly undermined when seeing nothing but constant lies and deceit in everyone older than themselves.

value.title: En el Fondo del Mar
value.synopsis: As the gang seeks information on the school's connection to Cristina Palacios Rodríguez, all but Iván encourage Paula to forgive Javier for decapitating Lola.

value.title: La Vida es Sueño
value.synopsis: With plumbing problems plaguing the school, Paula questions reality after repeatedly awakening inside a hospital. Marcos learns a horrifying fact about his parents' disappearance. Jacinta and Joaquin strike a deal.

value.title: La Peor Carcel del Mundo
value.synopsis: An injured owl leads Paula to consider the value of being free, thereby risking death, against the safety and boredom of living in a cage - a lesson lived out by others at the boarding school.

value.title: El Fantasma de la Profesora Decapitada
value.synopsis: Marcos' secret relationship becomes less secret, Julia heeds Paula when she says that ghosts appear when they have something important to convey, and Mateo experiences horror.

value.title: Los Cinco Vengadores
value.synopsis: A note discovered at the abandoned playground of the old orphanage reveals the names of "The Five Avengers" plus a sixth who survived.

value.title: La Noche del Fuego
value.synopsis: As the school prepares for its annual bonfire (where flames wait to accept wishes and purge bad memories), two teachers face death, one teacher faces expulsion, a student remains ostracized, and a prisoner escapes.
